Product Development Job Roles Responsibilities

  1. Be the Operational Truth Source for the Platform. You will be accountable for validating that platform outputs make sense in the real world. This includes:

  • Interpreting real-world contract logic (lesser-of, modifiers, MCO products, effective dates)
  • Reading raw 835 remits and identifying: Reimbursement issues vs legitimate adjustments; Payer miss configuration vs provider error; Systemic vs one-off issues

  1. Own Synthetic Data Realism (Critical). The platform will initially rely on synthetic data for development and validation. You will:
  • Define what realistic synthetic data looks like: payer mix, CARC/RARC distributions, modifier usage patterns, underpayment frequency and dollar impact
  • Review synthetic data sets and flag unrealistic assumptions
  • Guide engineers and vendors on correcting synthetic data generation logic. This role protects the credibility of everything we build.
  1. Be Deeply Embedded in Testing Validation. You will be hands-on in:
  • Reviewing detection outputs and classifying true vs false positives
  • Validating confidence scores against operational reality
  • Helping define suggested next step classifications (appeal, rebill, review, do not pursue)
  • Testing against real customer data during pilot phases. Your feedback will directly shape detection logic, confidence thresholds, and future AI agent behavior. You are effectively the human-in-the-loop backbone of the system.

About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate we re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. If you re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role

We are looking for a Principal AI Security Specialist to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to Ron Burkett. As enterprises race to adopt generative AI, Zscaler is seeking an experienced Principal AI Security Specialist to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI innovation and robust enterprise security. In this highly strategic, field-facing role, you will combine the elite consultative strengths of a Solutions Engineer with deep expertise in LLMs, RAG architectures, and data protection to serve as a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 executives. As our premier technical authority, you will help customers confidently unlock the power of AI without compromising their data or infrastructure.

  • Architect the AI Technical Strategy: Partner with enterprise account teams to own and execute the technical sales strategy, driving complex, high-value AI security opportunities from discovery to close

  • Deliver Compelling, High-Impact Demos & POVs: Configure and present tailored, outcome-driven demonstrations of Zscaler s AI security platform that resonate with both deep-tech practitioners and C-level executives

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert: Act as the field authority on modern AI patterns (such as RAG, agents, and prompt workflows), advising clients on how to prevent sensitive data exposure and unsanctioned AI usage

  • Scale the Field Motion: Collaborate with Product and Engineering to inject real-world customer feedback into the product roadmap, while building reusable demo assets and enablement playbooks to upscale our global sales force

  • Enable Those Around You: Develop reusable demos, technical assets, competitive positioning, and enablement content to help scale Zscaler s AI field motion while sharing best practices and training with enterprise account teams

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity, remaining comfortable building the path as you walk it and viewing dynamic environments as the raw material to create something meaningful.

  • You act like an owner, letting your passion for the mission fuel a strong bias for action while navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embracing a challenge culture by giving and receiving candor with clarity and respect.

  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for both internal and external customers to anchor decisions in solving real-world problems.

  • You are driven by innovation, possessing a deep curiosity for how things work and an energy for solving complex technical challenges to accelerate secure transformation.

What We re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Deep Fluency in AI/GenAI: Strong foundational knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), MCP (Model Context Protocol) orchestration patterns, and the inherent security risks associated with them

  • 10+ Years of Solutions Engineering Mastery: A proven track record in a customer-facing technical role (Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Advisory) navigating complex, enterprise-level sales cycles

  • Enterprise Security Foundations: Solid grasp of cybersecurity principles, including Zero Trust architecture, data loss prevention (DLP), cloud-native security platforms, and API integrations

  • Elite Executive Communication: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with a demonstrated ability to seamlessly translate complex AI architectures into tangible business value and security outcomes

  • Collaborate and Co-elevate: Successfully work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams in a hyper-growth, rapidly evolving market

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Hands-on AI Prototyping: Interacting with LLM APIs, scripting, creating agentic automation routines, and building lightweight AI applications

  • Advanced AI Risk Expertise: Direct experience helping enterprises deploy production AI technologies while navigating data leakage, model governance, compliance frameworks, and shadow AI usage

title: Custom Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Must have skills : Web Application Development

Good to have skills : Content Management, API Management
Minimum
3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Role Overview
The Back-End Web Developer will support the Marketing organization by developing and maintaining the back-end website architecture, CMS functionality, integrations, APIs, data structures, and technical foundations that power the global marketing website and related digital properties. This role will be part of the U.S.-led Web Operations team and will partner closely with the Director of Digital Experience & Web Strategy, front-end development, web operations resources, IT, SEO, analytics, UX/design partners, and business stakeholders.
The ideal candidate should bring strong back-end development fundamentals, CMS architecture experience, integration capability, and comfort working across modern, scalable, AI-enabled digital experience environments. This is not intended to be a basic website maintenance role it is focused on building reliable, secure, scalable, and future-ready web platform capabilities.
This role will help ensure the website platform can support structured content, component reuse, personalization, intelligent search, forms, integrations, analytics, SEO/AEO/GEO requirements, global/multilingual content needs, governance, and future AI-forward digital experiences. Develop, enhance, and maintain back-end website functionality, CMS content models, schemas, integrations, APIs, and platform capabilities across the global marketing website and related digital properties.
Support back-end development for the Sanity CMS headless architecture, including schema design, GROQ queries, Sanity Studio customization, and API layer development within the Next.js framework.
Build and maintain scalable content models, taxonomies, structured content schemas, workflows, permissions, reusable content blocks, and publishing processes in Sanity that support global marketing needs.
Partner with the front-end developer to ensure back-end content structures, APIs, GROQ queries, forms, and integrations properly support front-end components and user experiences built with React, shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, and Storybook.
Experience working in agile/scrum workflows with 23 week sprint cycles, including the ability to lead sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives within a small, self-managing development team.
Support website integrations with marketing technology, analytics, forms, CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Pardot), chatbot/conversational tools (Qualified), personalization platforms (Optimizely), intent data platforms (6sense), DAM (Bynder), localization (Smartling), consent tools, and other connected systems.
Ensure back-end implementation supports SEO, AEO/GEO, structured content, schema markup, metadata, redirects, performance, analytics tagging (GA4/GTM), and conversion tracking requirements.
Support data, content, and platform readiness for AI-forward digital experiences, including structured content, intelligent search, personalization, guided journeys, chatbot integrations, AI content tools (Jasper), and future automation use cases.
Maintain security, performance, reliability, scalability, accessibility support, and code quality across back-end website development work.
Participate in QA, UAT, troubleshooting, regression testing, release validation, issue resolution, and production support for website enhancements and launches.
Document back-end configuration, Sanity content models, integration logic, dependencies, release processes, and technical standards that enable the Web Operations team to scale.
Work within Git, version control, code review, CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and agile delivery processes to ensure high-quality and controlled releases.
Use AI-enabled coding tools and modern development practices to improve speed, quality, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement while maintaining strong development judgment.
Required Skills and Experience
5+ years of professional web development experience.
Strong hands-on experience with back-end web development, headless CMS implementation, and modern web platform architecture.
2+ years of experience with Sanity CMS, including content modeling, schema design, GROQ queries, and Sanity Studio customization or equivalent experience with another headless CMS (Contentful, Strapi, Hygraph) with demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on Sanity.
3+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js in a production environment.
Experience with React and Next.js (server components, API routes, SSR/SSG) sufficient to build and maintain server-side logic and data-fetching layers.
Strong understanding of CMS content modeling, structured content, taxonomies, workflows, permissions, reusable components, and publishing structures in a headless/decoupled architecture.
Experience managing hosting and infrastructure for production web applications (Vercel, Netlify, or similar cloud platforms).
Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and GraphQL and integrating third-party services, CRM/marketing technology connections, analytics tools, and web platform dependencies.
Understanding of SEO, structured content, schema markup, metadata, redirects, site performance, accessibility support, analytics tagging, and conversion tracking considerations.
Experience with content migration, environment management, deployment processes, and platform troubleshooting.
Experience supporting secure, scalable, reliable, and performant web platforms in enterprise or large-scale environments.
Experience working with Git, version control, code review, CI/CD pipelines, release processes, and agile development workflows.
Familiarity with AI-enabled development tools, copilots, automated testing, debugging, or workflow automation is preferred.
Experience with B2B, SaaS, global, multilingual, or enterprise marketing websites is required.

Nice-to-Have Skills
Experience with modern UI development using Tailwind CSS and reusable component libraries.
Familiarity with component documentation and design systems (e.g., Storybook, shadcn/ui).
Exposure to web analytics, A/B testing, and personalization platforms.
Experience integrating CMS, CRM, marketing automation, or DAM platforms.
Understanding of internationalization (i18n) and localization workflows.
Exposure to AI-driven content solutions and headless CMS migration initiatives.

Strong back-end web developer with expertise in headless CMS platforms, Sanity CMS, Next.js, APIs, and scalable web architectures. After launch, you will act as the business owner for the incubated practice - setting its roadmap, sharpening the proposition and delivery model, watching commercial performance, and building the repeatability it needs to become a standalone unit.

This is not a traditional software product management role. It blends market strategy, services design, product marketing, commercial ownership, and venture incubation. You are as comfortable building a market landscape and modeling unit economics as you are shaping a client-ready offer, creating sales enablement, and leading cross-functional execution.

Responsibilities

Opportunity discovery & market validation

  • Build and manage a pipeline of new-service ideas.
  • Conduct structured market, customer, category, and competitor research.
  • Define the ideal customer profile, economic buyer, priority use cases, customer pain points and desired outcomes.
  • Lead interviews and working sessions with clients, prospects, sales, delivery teams, product leaders, subject-matter experts, and partners.

Business case, pricing & investment recommendation

  • Build decision-grade business cases that connect market opportunity, strategic fit, client value, investment requirements, risks, and expected business impact.
  • Define pricing, packaging, contract structure, and monetization options - fixed fees, subscriptions, usage or outcome-based fees, revenue share, and hybrid models.
  • Translate assumptions into an executive recommendation and a clear investment ask; track actual performance against the approved case and update the forecast as evidence improves.

Service product design & productization

  • Turn a validated opportunity into a repeatable, sellable offer with a defined customer, outcome, scope, deliverables, methodology, timeline, dependencies, exclusions, and acceptance criteria.
  • Design the end-to-end service blueprint: client journey, discovery and design activities, delivery workflows, roles and RACI, governance, data and technology requirements, quality controls, SLAs, and KPI framework.
  • Translate service requirements into a prioritized roadmap for platform, data, analytics, automation, and internal tooling in partnership with product and engineering.

GTM & sales enablement

  • Partner with Marketing to define the name, positioning, value proposition, audience, messaging architecture, launch plan, and campaign strategy.
  • Create client-ready sales materials: offering decks, one-pagers, vertical use cases, executive narratives, case studies, ROI tools, proposal content, demo stories, objection handling, and competitive battlecards.
  • Translate complex capabilities into clear stories that connect the customer requirement, the service or solution design, the commercial logic, and the measurable outcome.

Launch, roadmap & practice incubation

  • Own cross-functional launch readiness: milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, enablement, delivery capacity, operational controls, measurement, and executive reporting.
  • Maintain the post-launch roadmap and prioritized backlog across proposition, methodology, commercial model, sales enablement, delivery operations, technology, analytics, and partner ecosystem.
  • Create the operating cadence for the practice: performance dashboards, pipeline and delivery reviews, roadmap decisions, client feedback loops, and quarterly business reviews.

Graduation to a standalone unit

  • Prepare the scale plan: market focus, product and service roadmap, P&L and forecast, organization design, hiring profile, partner model, governance, and investment needs.
  • Transition the practice to its permanent leader with clear ownership, documented IP and processes, an active roadmap, trained teams, customer and pipeline context, and a complete performance baseline.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent practical experience. MBA / PGDM would be ideal.
  • 5+ years in services product management, consulting offer development, strategy, professional services, product marketing, corporate innovation, venture building, or a closely related role.
  • Demonstrated success taking at least one B2B service, solution, or practice from concept through launch and into measurable commercial growth.
  • Direct experience building business cases and financial models used to inform real investment decisions - not academic exercises.
  • Experience presenting solutions and recommendations to senior client and internal stakeholders, including executives.
  • Strong market research and customer discovery skills, with the ability to turn incomplete signals into a structured point of view and testable hypotheses.
  • Commercial and financial fluency - business-case development, pricing and packaging, scenario modeling, unit economics, margin, forecasting, and investment recommendations.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
jobDescription:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprintos extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we dont wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams arent built by sitting together; theyre built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.

What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. Its used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.

Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.

Where youll leave your mark

Agents whose output nobody re-checks. Youll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts - a platform every other team builds on. Youll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.

A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didnt know. Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.

Beyond those two, there are surfaces youll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, well expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.

The kind of builder were looking for -

  • Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype - a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. Well want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it.

  • An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. Were more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one.

  • Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules.

  • 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope - setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed.

  • Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters its the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters its carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt.

  • Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. Were hiring partly for disagreement - on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we cant yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal.

  • Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX - and since were remote-first, most of that happens in writing.

How we care for our Sprinters
  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

Were proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Technical Consultant - Shift Lead (Shared Data/ODSP Tenant Migration)
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) in the Shared Data/ODSP Factory, you will lead on-shift technical delivery for tenant-to-tenant migrations of collaboration content across Microsoft 365, typically SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and associated Teams/M365 Group content structures. You will run a controlled, metrics-driven migration factory, ensuring runbooks are executed consistently, migrations are scheduled and monitored, permissions/metadata fidelity is validated and defects are remediated efficiently. You will be accountable for shift throughput, quality gates, evidence capture and operational reporting while coordinating escalations and ensuring seamless handovers across the 24x7 model.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical execution of SharePoint/OneDrive/ODSP migration waves during your shift, ensuring runbook adherence and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift triage for failures (throttling, permissions mapping issues, blocked files, metadata/versioning exceptions, large list/library constraints, URL/path constraints).
  • Validate readiness: source/target access, migration accounts/consents, pre-checks, quota constraints and cutover schedule alignment.
  • Configure, schedule and monitor migration jobs using the approved toolset (native and/or third-party), proactively identifying risks before they become wave blockers.
  • Enforce quality gates: sampling/validation outcomes, permission parity checks, metadata fidelity and user experience verification.
  • Maintain operational control of the shift backlog and prioritise tasks based on cutover plans, dependencies and SLA.
  • Produce and manage evidence packs per wave: migration reports, exception logs, remediation records, sign-off artefacts and audit trail completeness.
  • Coordinate handovers with clear exceptions, blockers and next actions; ensure continuity of long-running migration jobs across shifts.
  • Drive continuous improvement: update runbooks, known error catalogues and operational dashboards; reduce recurring failures and rework.
  • Manage escalations (vendor support, platform support pathways, programme technical leadership) with complete diagnostic context and clear asks.

Requirements

  • Delivered at least one production tenant-to-tenant migration of SharePoint Online and/or OneDrive (ODSP) content as a senior SME/lead.
  • Deep expertise in SharePoint Online/OneDrive architecture concepts relevant to migration: site structures, permissions models, sharing/links, metadata/versioning, information architecture constraints.
  • Hands-on experience with migration tooling in this space (e.g., ShareGate and/or Quest ODM or equivalent) and the ability to run migrations at scale.
  • Proven ability to run migration operations in a factory model: scheduling, monitoring, exception handling and quality gates at high volume.
  • Strong understanding of security/compliance impacts in migrated content (sensitivity labels/retention behaviours where applicable; access governance, least privilege).
  • Strong runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable being held to audit standards for every wave.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience migrating Teams-associated content dependencies (files in SharePoint, OneDrive artefacts linked to user data used by collaboration features) and coordinating sequencing.
  • Familiarity with multi-geo considerations and URL/domain nuances that can impact migration execution.
  • Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365 administration (e.g., MS-102) or SharePoint specialization, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience using PowerShell/Graph for reporting, bulk checks, or automation around migration readiness and validation.
  • Knowledge of data governance, information architecture and content lifecycle management in Microsoft 365.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Keeps shift teams focused on plan and standards; prevents uncontrolled variation in execution.
  • Communicates clearly with upstream/downstream disciplines (Identity, Teams, Adoption, Security) to manage dependencies and unblock progress.
  • Escalates early and responsibly with evidence; avoids late surprises.
  • Coaches engineers to solve problems systematically (root cause, pattern recognition, runbook refinement).
  • Strong stakeholder communication habits suitable for a major programme: concise, factual, action-oriented updates.
  • Builds trust through calm leadership during cutovers and operational incidents.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: sites/OneDrives migrated per shift; data volume migrated vs plan.
  • Defect rate: percentage of migrations requiring re-run; recurring exception types reduced over time.
  • MTTR: resolution time for migration blockers and priority incidents.
  • Evidence capture: percentage of waves with complete exportable reports and sign-off records.
  • SLA: scheduled cutovers achieved on time with managed risk and exceptions logged.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

This role operates within a three-shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

title: Senior Enterprise Software Test Engineer
jobDescription:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life Medtronic is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Sr Software Test Engineer - Automation to join our Affera Mapping and Ablation System team. This role is essential in supporting the testing and quality assurance processes to ensure the reliability and performance of our advanced medical devices. You will be an integral member of the Affera Software Team, working on cutting-edge technology in the electrophysiology field.

In this role, you will contribute to the development and validation of innovative medical technology by designing and implementing robust automated testing solutions. You will collaborate with systems, software, hardware, and quality engineering teams to ensure software functionality meets product and regulatory requirements.
You will analyze workflows, identify potential quality risks, develop automated test strategies, and support continuous improvement of the software development and verification lifecycle.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks for complex software systems.
  • Develop automated tests to verify software requirements and ensure product reliability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including software, systems, hardware, and quality engineering.
  • Investigate and implement new automation tools and technologies to improve testing efficiency.
  • Analyze software workflows and identify areas for improved testing coverage.
  • Apply software development lifecycle processes and verification best practices.
  • Create and maintain detailed test protocols and documentation.
  • Execute automated and manual tests to verify system functionality.
  • Diagnose and debug software issues in collaboration with development teams.
  • Ensure compliance with medical device regulatory standards and quality processes.
  • Maintain multiple hardware and software test configurations.
  • Work with engineers to resolve software defects and diagnose/improve product configuration for current and future models.
  • Participate in innovation and continuous improvement initiatives related to testing and automation.

Required knowledge and Experience:

  • Bachelor s degree in computer science software engineering or equivalent with 8 to 12 years of relevant experience. Bio-Medical expertise will be preferred.
  • Strong programming experience in languages such as Python, C# or C++.
  • Experience testing on Web / Desktop Applications.
  • Experience designing and implementing test automation frameworks.
  • Experience with software verification and validation processes.
  • Familiarity with software development lifecycle methodologies.
  • Experience collaborating with cross functional engineering teams.
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum development environments.
  • Experience with hardware debugging tools such as oscilloscopes or function generators.
  • Experience / Knowledge of HIL (Hardware in the Loop) framework.
  • Ability to manage, track and upgrade multiple hardware and software configurations.
  • Experience using version control systems such as Git.
  • Familiarity with test management tools such as Polarion, TestRail, JAMA, or TFS.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent documentation and communication skills.
  • Quality Management System - Test Planning, Strategy.
  • Ability to work with QA to ensure testing meets Quality and Regulatory needs.
    Nice to have:
  • Experience with QT/QML
  • Experience working with Linux environments is preferred.
  • Experience with UI automation tools such as Ranorex, Appium, Katalon, or Squish.
  • Experience in medical device software development or regulated environments.
  • Knowledge of medical device standards such as IEC 62304 and FDA software guidance.
  • Knowledge on CI-CD Workflow. Docker.
  • Knowledge of AI tool usage. Like Co-Pilot, Cursor.
  • Experience with system-level testing of integrated hardware and software platforms.

jobDescription:
Who We Are


Orgzit is a SaaS software product business. We help small and mid-sized businesses implement systems in their sales, operations, and accounting functions with CRM & workflow automation software solutions.


Our unique value proposition is our no-code technology advantage, which enables us to offer customised business software solutions that are the easiest to use and implement in the shortest time.

Orgzit was founded in 2016 by Pavan Verma and Nitin Verma to solve the problems of SMBs they experienced firsthand in their family and friends' businesses. Over the past 9+ years, we have served more than 100 businesses. Our customers rely on our product daily to automate their sales and operational processes and grow their businesses.

We are a member of two accelerators: Upekkha, the #1 accelerator for SaaS businesses in India, and Nasscom Startups. We are a profitable business and are investing in growing 100% every year for the next five years.


Our customer, Carolyn Arote of CAVH from Florida, USA, says, My team is able to track all sales-related things on Orgzit. It has been worth its weight in Gold.


Our team member Karan Asthana says, “Orgzit has a very open, transparent, and friendly culture. You get to work closely with visionary founders and build a world-class business. It is the best place for someone who wants to learn and become a master of their domain.”

Watch this video to discover why you should join us and be part of building a new generation of business software.


Visit our website at https://orgzit.com to learn more about us.


Who Are We Looking For


We're looking for a highly organised, trustworthy Executive Assistant who can manage accounts, HR, recruitment, and founder support with equal ease. The ideal Executive Assistant is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable juggling multiple workstreams without dropping the ball. Above all, they should be someone who takes ownership, learns fast, and wants to grow with a young, fast-moving startup.


Key Responsibilities


  • Accounts & Finance: Own end-to-end accounting operations: invoicing, expense tracking, monthly GST/TDS filings and payments, P&L dashboard reporting.
  • HR & People Operations: Be the single point of contact for all team member matters: onboarding/offboarding, leave records, payroll inputs, and appraisals. Run the monthly performance review cycle (inputs ratings 1-1s) and drive team connection through weekly check-ins and quarterly team events.
  • Recruitment: Run recruitment drives start to finish: draft JDs, post on job portals, schedule webinars and interviews.
  • Founder & Admin Support: Manage the founder's calendar, inbox, and notes. Set up meetings with customers and manage team access to software tools and applications.

Skills Required


  • Communication: Clear, precise, and confident in both written and verbal communication.
  • Organisation & Attention to Detail: Manages multiple workstreams (accounts, HR, recruitment, admin) without missing tasks.
  • Proactive Ownership: Anticipates needs before being asked and takes initiative to close gaps.
  • Reliability: Dependable and consistent.
  • Discretion & Integrity: Trusted with confidential information, including founder communications, compensation data, and team matters, and handles it with judgment and professionalism..
  • Coordination & Follow-through: Keeps multiple people (team members, candidates, vendors, freelancers) moving toward deadlines without needing constant reminders.
  • Tool Fluency: Comfortable working across Google Sheets, Google Docs, Slack, etc. to move fast and reduce manual effort.
  • AI Tool Proficiency: Skilled at using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude for research, drafting documents, and writing messages.
  • Ability to learn quickly and apply feedback in real time.

Work Location


  • This position is a work-from-office role.
  • Office location: Sector 44, Gurgaon (near Millennium City Centre metro station)

Work Days and Timings


  • Days: Monday to Friday + alternate Saturdays
  • Timings: 10am to 7pm

Compensation


  • Full-time CTC: Rs. 3,60,00 to 4,20,000 per annum

Experience

  • 1+ years of experience.

Benefits


  • Medical insurance
  • Leave encashment
  • Relocation assistance

Why Join Us


As a small, bootstrapped, fast-growing startup, we strive to provide a supportive and rewarding work environment that values our team members’ contributions. We provide an unparalleled environment to professionals looking to grow in their careers:

  • Growth Opportunities: Take on new responsibilities, learn, and grow personally and professionally
  • Ownership and Impact: Make a significant impact on our company's direction and growth
  • Collaborative Environment: Foster teamwork, open communication, and mutual respect
  • Rapid Learning: Wear multiple hats, develop diverse skills, and gain valuable experience
  • Recognition and Appreciation: Your contributions are recognised and celebrated
  • Transparent Communication: Stay informed with open updates about company progress and opportunities.

Please note: This role is intended as a growth path: we're looking for someone who is eager to learn the operational and financial backbone of a growing SaaS business from the ground up. Strong performance during the internship will lead directly to a full-time role and growing responsibility over time.

Job Description


Brilliant Infotech Inc. is a US-headquartered IT services and technology solutions company with a delivery centre in Noida. We work with enterprise clients across financial services, insurance, logistics, retail, and the public sector.

As we expand our AI and technology solutions business, we are looking for an Inside Sales Executive with 35 years of experience selling IT services, technology solutions, or IT staffing to the US market.

The successful candidate will own outbound sales end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification through discovery, proposal, negotiation, and closure. This is not a lead-generation-only or appointment-setting role.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities for IT services and technology solutions in the US market.
  • Conduct outbound prospecting through cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn, and other sales channels.
  • Research target accounts and identify relevant business and technology decision-makers.
  • Engage prospects including technology leaders, business leaders, engineering managers, IT managers, and other decision-makers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound opportunities based on business requirements, fit, budget, timeline, and decision-making process.
  • Schedule and conduct discovery calls with qualified prospects.
  • Understand client requirements and position relevant Brilliant Infotech services and solutions.
  • Own the outbound sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through discovery, proposal, negotiation, follow-up, and closure.
  • Build and maintain an active sales pipeline against monthly and quarterly targets.
  • Consistently follow up with prospects and move qualified opportunities through the sales pipeline.
  • Maintain accurate prospect, activity, pipeline, and opportunity information in CRM.
  • Coordinate with US leadership, technical, delivery, and recruiting teams on client requirements, proposals, and solutions.


Solutions You Will Sell

  • Artificial Intelligence and AI Automation
  • AI Agents and Generative AI Solutions
  • Cloud and DevOps Services
  • Data Engineering and Analytics
  • Application Development
  • Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Services
  • IT Staffing and Technology Consulting

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3-5 years of experience in Inside Sales, Business Development, IT Sales, or Technology Sales.
  • Prior experience selling IT services, software/technology solutions, or IT staffing to the US market.
  • Demonstrated experience in outbound prospecting and new client acquisition.
  • Strong cold calling, email outreach, and LinkedIn prospecting skills.
  • Ability to identify and engage business and technology decision-makers within US companies.
  • Experience qualifying opportunities and managing a B2B sales pipeline.
  • Ability to take qualified opportunities beyond meeting generation and contribute directly to proposal, negotiation, and closure.
  • Excellent spoken and written English with the ability to communicate confidently with US-based clients and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience using CRM and sales prospecting tools.
  • Target-driven and comfortable working against measurable pipeline and revenue goals.
  • Willing and able to work US shift hours from our Noida office.

Preferred Skills


  • Experience selling AI, Cloud, DevOps, Data Engineering, Application Development, or related IT services.
  • Experience with IT staffing and technology consulting sales.
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar sales tools.
  • Good understanding of the US IT services and technology market.
  • Experience developing new accounts from cold/outbound prospecting.

What We Are Looking For


We are looking for someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, opening new accounts, building relationships with decision-makers, and progressing opportunities toward revenue.

title: Senior Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer to design and scale intelligent automation across Oktas Enterprise Technology ecosystem. This role will reduce manual operational work, improve developer productivity, and accelerate the software delivery lifecycle across platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, AEM, Boomi, identity systems, CI/CD platforms, and other enterprise applications.
The engineer will build reliable automation services, reusable integration patterns, and AI-assisted developer agents that understand source code, metadata, configuration, tickets, documentation, deployment history, and operational context. These solutions will automate release activities, identify deployment risks, reduce merge-conflict resolution effort, improve environment management, and enable safe self-service operations.
The role requires a combination of software engineering, enterprise application expertise, API and integration development, CI/CD automation, security engineering, and practical experience applying AI to developer and operational workflows. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between platform-specific technologies and building scalable, secure, platform-agnostic automation frameworks.
What you\'ll be doing Intelligent Automation and Developer Productivity
  • Build AI-assisted developer agents and automation services that reduce repetitive engineering and operational work.
  • Use contextual information from Git repositories, metadata, tickets, documentation, deployment logs, and platform APIs to make automation more accurate and useful.
  • Automate release planning, validation, dependency analysis, testing, deployment coordination, post-release verification, and rollback activities.
  • Build tools that detect potential merge conflicts, explain their impact, and recommend or execute safe resolutions with appropriate human approval.
  • Develop agents that assist with code and metadata analysis, documentation, test generation, troubleshooting, incident response, and operational runbooks.
  • Establish metrics to measure productivity gains, manual effort reduction, deployment quality, and automation adoption.
Cross-Platform Enterprise Automation
  • Design and implement automation across Salesforce, NetSuite, AEM, Boomi, Okta, GitHub, CI/CD systems, ticketing platforms, and other ET applications.
  • Build reusable APIs, connectors, scripts, workflows, and event-driven services.
  • Create platform-agnostic automation patterns for authentication, authorization, retries, error handling, logging, monitoring, and auditability.
  • Develop self-service capabilities that allow teams to safely perform approved tasks without direct manual intervention.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve end-to-end workflows spanning multiple enterprise applications.
Salesforce Platform Engineering and Security
  • Design and optimize Salesforce Flows, declarative automation, Apex utilities, and platform integrations.
  • Implement Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, FLS, Sharing Rules, OWDs, Shield, Event Monitoring, and related security controls.
  • Build data masking and lower-environment protection processes for sensitive information.
  • Debug and refactor platform automation to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Review third-party packages, Connected Apps, OAuth configurations, and API access in partnership with Security and Privacy teams.
Release, CI/CD, and Environment Automation
  • Eliminate manual deployment and environment-management steps through automation.
  • Build CI/CD integrations for metadata validation, testing, deployment, approvals, and rollback.
  • Automate sandbox refreshes, data masking, metadata synchronization, configuration updates, and post-refresh activities.
  • Maintain automation code and configuration in GitHub using appropriate branching, testing, review, and release practices.
  • Partner with Release Engineering and DevSecOps teams to standardize deployment and operational patterns
Automation Security, Governance, and Reliability
  • Implement least-privilege access for service accounts, agents, integrations, and automation workflows.
  • Apply guardrails and human approval controls to high-risk actions.
  • Protect sensitive data used by automation and AI systems.
  • Maintain comprehensive execution logs, audit trails, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Design for reliability through testing, idempotency, retries, failure recovery, and rollback.
  • Establish governance standards for secure and responsible use of AI-enabled automation
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise automation, platform engineering, DevOps, integration engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience building production-grade automation that reduces manual operational or development work.
  • Strong programming experience in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Java, or a similar language.
  • Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, event-driven workflows, asynchronous processing, and SaaS integrations.
  • Experience with Git/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, release engineering, and environment management.
  • Experience with at least two enterprise platforms, preferably including Salesforce, NetSuite, AEM, Boomi, Okta, or comparable systems.
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience with Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, Salesforce CLI, metadata APIs, and platform security.
  • Experience designing reusable automation frameworks, internal tools, CLI utilities, or developer platforms.
  • Practical experience integrating LLMs or AI services into enterprise workflows, developer tools, or operational automation.
  • Understanding of agentic workflows, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, context management, and human-in-the-loop automation.
  • Experience implementing security controls for APIs, service accounts, connected applications, secrets, data access, and automation infrastructure.
  • Strong debugging, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Salesforce Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Platform Developer I certification.
  • Experience with Salesforce Shield, Event Monitoring, security audits, or data masking.
  • Experience with NetSuite, AEM, Boomi, Okta, ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, or similar enterprise platforms.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI or comparable CI/CD technologies.
  • Experience with cloud services such as AWS or GCP, including serverless functions, queues, secrets management, and observability.
  • Experience with agent frameworks, LLM APIs, vector databases, RAG systems, or AI evaluation frameworks.
  • Experience building developer agents for code review, release engineering, incident management, testing, or platform operations.
  • Experience working in a large, geographically distributed enterprise environment.

About TYLsemi, Inc.

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package

Thats what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.

This isnt a nice-to-have. Its the critical path.

Why Now The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:

  • Moores Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.
  • Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - theyre all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.
  • IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.
  • Translation: Were entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what were building, and their alternatives are disappearing.


Culture Team: How We Work No Politics, No Bureaucracy

title: Lead - Computer Vision & AI Architect
jobDescription:
We are looking for a Lead Computer Vision & AI Architect to own the technical direction of our core perception stack while staying deeply hands-on. You will lead the design of our real-time movement-perception system multi-camera geometry, 3D pose and mesh estimation, personalized body modeling, live form evaluation, Vision-Language coaching models, and edge deployment and you will also carry end-to-end responsibility for how these pieces fit together as one coherent system across capture, edge runtime, mobile app, and cloud.


This is a hybrid technical-lead and product-ownership role, not a pure people-management position. You will set the perception roadmap, own module-level requirements and acceptance criteria, plan and run execution, and act as the primary technical bridge across engineering, design, hardware, and partner integrations. You will mentor a small, senior team through design and code review — formal people management is not the core of the role today, but technical leadership and delivery ownership are.


Key Responsibilities


1. Technical Leadership & Execution Ownership

  • Technical Direction: Set and own architecture decisions across 3D pose, multi-camera geometry, body/mesh modeling, form evaluation, and edge deployment — and be accountable for their trade-offs.
  • Product Ownership: Translate product goals into clear module-level requirements, scope, priorities, and acceptance criteria for the perception program; decide what ships and what defers.
  • Execution Management: Plan and run sprints, sequence cross-module work, and manage delivery against milestones and measurable KPIs (latency, frame rate, calibration repeatability, demo reliability).
  • Engineering Practice: Foster clean coding, thoughtful design and code reviews, automated testing, clear documentation, and reproducible experiment tracking. Mentor CV and AI/ML engineers technically.

2. System Architecture & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • System Coherence: Own end-to-end architecture coherence across capture, perception, edge runtime, mobile app, and cloud — not just the CV core, but how the whole movement-intelligence loop connects.
  • Interfaces & Dependencies: Define and manage cross-module interface contracts and dependencies so parallel workstreams integrate cleanly.
  • Cross-Functional Bridge: Coordinate day-to-day across full-stack engineering, UI/UX, CV and ML/CV engineers, and — as the team grows — edge/embedded and hardware/firmware engineers, plus partner integrations.
  • Performance Budgets: Establish and enforce real-time latency, frame-rate, memory, and thermal budgets across edge hardware, smart glasses, Linux workstations, and NPUs — from current real-time demo targets (sub-second feedback at 10–15 FPS on Jetson-class simulation) toward productization targets (sub-200ms feedback at 30–60 FPS).

3. Hands-On Computer Vision & 3D Geometry

  • Multi-View Geometry & 3D Pose: Lead hands-on development of camera calibration, multi-camera synchronization, epipolar geometry, 3D joint triangulation, and temporal smoothing across a multi-camera capture rig.
  • Personalized Body Modeling & Form Evaluation: Build pose-to-mesh alignment against a user-specific skeletal/mesh model and a live form-comparison engine that turns movement variance into timely, trustworthy corrective cues.

4. Multimodal AI & Edge Deployment

  • Multimodal AI: Guide evaluation and fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) of Vision-Language Models (e.g. LLaVA, Qwen-VL) for movement interpretation and coaching dialogue.
  • Edge Optimization: Oversee quantization (INT8/FP16) and export to ONNX, TensorRT, TFLite, or CoreML, and real-time inference on Jetson-class edge and NPU targets.

5. R&D and Intellectual Property

  • Patent-Protected Innovation: Help build and document patentable core technology in mirror-aware tracking, personalized 3D motion reconstruction, and real-time form evaluation.

What We Are Looking For

Experience & Leadership

  • Background: 7–10 years in computer vision, AI, or ML engineering, with a track record of owning technical direction and architecture on complex, real-time systems.
  • Hands-On + Coordination: Demonstrated ability to stay deeply hands-on in code while also leading architectural reviews, driving execution, and coordinating delivery across cross-functional teams.
  • Delivery: Proven record of shipping complex engineering projects against deadlines, with rigorous benchmarking and clear technical decision-making.

Computer Vision & 3D Geometry

  • Core Math: Strong grasp of 3D geometry (rigid-body transforms, quaternions, rotation matrices) and projective geometry (calibration, bundle adjustment, triangulation).
  • Pose Systems: Practical experience with 2D/3D pose models (e.g. ViTPose, HRNet, RTMPose, MediaPipe) and multi-camera setups.
  • Toolkit: High proficiency in Python (NumPy, SciPy), OpenCV, and performance-oriented C++.

AI/ML & Multimodal AI

  • Frameworks: Strong experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Multimodal Models: Hands-on work evaluating and fine-tuning Vision-Language Models (VLMs).
  • Agentic AI: Familiarity with agent systems, tool calling, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a plus.

Edge & Deployment

  • Hardware Targets: Experience delivering real-time models to mobile SoCs, NPUs, smart glasses, or embedded hardware.
  • Optimization Tools: Hands-on experience with TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, TFLite, or CoreML.

Nice to Have

  • Education: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related field.
  • Publications or Patents: Work published at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or NeurIPS, or granted patents.

Summary:
As a Python Developer you design, build, and deploy AI Agents workflow integration that can reason, plan, and execute complex workflows with minimal human intervention.
This role sits at the intersection of developing agents'' workflows with Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Crew AI, AutoGen and Implement patterns such as planning delegation and Tool orchestration.
You will build production-grade AI agents that integrate with enterprise systems, use tools dynamically, and operate across multi-step workflows to deliver real business outcomes.

Roles Responsibilities:
  • Work with generative AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and autonomous agents
  • Design and develop AI agents that can reason, plan, and execute multi-step tasks autonomously
  • Implement agent capabilities such as, Tool calling, Memory management and multi-agent collaboration
  • Apply software engineering best practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Incorporate ethical AI principles, bias mitigation strategies, and security best practices into the design and deployment of autonomous systems.
  • Build REST APIs and microservices for AI-driven platforms for workflow integrations with Agentic AI solutions.


    Professional Technical Skills:
  • Must Have Skills: Proficiency in Python, AI Agents Workflow Integration, AI LLM Foundations- Understanding large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models, Prompt engineering and structured prompting, Hands on experience with AWS KIRO, Spec Driven Development, Knowledge of fine-tuning, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
  • Agentic Orchestration- Frameworks like Lang Chain, Crew AI, Semantic Kernel, Lang graph, multi-agent coordination strategies (collaboration, delegation, planning, negotiation and Workflow orchestration (DAGs, state machines, planners)
  • Tool Integration- API design and integration for agent tooling, Connecting agents with databases, APIs, and enterprise systems and Knowledge of vector databases (cloud or on prem).
  • The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Python, AI Agents Workflow Integration, strong foundational knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Data Science, or a related field.
  • This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
  • A 15-year full time education is required.

title: Manager, Privacy Engineering & Data Protection Compliance
jobDescription:
Job Summary
The Manager- Privacy Engineering Data Protection Compliance sits within the Data Privacy Office (DPO), part of Equinixs Legal organisation, and is responsible for ensuring that data protection and privacy obligations are effectively implemented and operationalised across systems, processes, and business operations.
This role is technical and delivery-focused and will serve as a critical link between the Data Privacy Office (DPO), the Digital Innovation Organization (DIO) (particularly Information Security (InfoSec)), and other business functions across Equinix.
The successful candidate will:
  • Work with the DPO to translate legal and regulatory requirements into actionable technical and operational solutions
  • Support and drive the embedding of privacy-by-design, data governance, and AI governance into technology and business processes
  • Enable the development of scalable frameworks, controls, and tools to support compliance
  • Contribute to ongoing monitoring, KPI tracking, and audit-readiness of privacy and data protection controls
This role will act as the bridge between legal and technical teams to ensure that regulatory requirements are implemented in a practical, measurable, and sustainable way, enabling both compliance and innovation.
Responsibilities
Privacy Engineering, Compliance Implementation
  • Work with DPO to translate regulatory and legal requirements (e.g. GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, India DPDP Act, China PIPL, and other global privacy laws) into technical controls, system requirements, and operational processes
  • Lead and/or contribute to the design, creation, and continuous refinement of privacy, data protection, and security-related processes, standards, and policies to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and operational needs
  • Support and drive implementation of Privacy by Design across products, platforms, and internal systems
  • Partner with engineering, InfoSec, and product teams to embed privacy requirements into system architecture, development lifecycles, and operational workflows
  • Define, implement, and maintain technical and organisational measures (TOMs) aligned to legal obligations
  • Conduct and support hands-on technical evaluations, including: data flow analysis, system and architecture reviews, privacy impact/risk assessments
  • Contribute to the development of standardised patterns, guardrails, and reusable solutions for privacy compliance
Data Governance Lifecycle Management
  • Support and help drive implementation of data governance frameworks, including: data lifecycle management, data classification
  • Partner with business and technical teams to map data flows, processing activities, and system dependencies
  • Support development and simplification of operational controls
  • Enable consistent implementation of data handling standards across the enterprise
Data Security
  • Partner with InfoSec to ensure privacy requirements are embedded within data security controls and practices
  • Support compliance alignment with security frameworks and standards (e.g. ISO 27001, NIST)
  • Contribute to third-party risk management, vendor onboarding, and data security reviews
  • Support implementation of privacy-enhancing technologies (e.g. data masking, minimisation)
AI Governance Responsible Data Use
  • Support and help drive implementation of AI governance frameworks, including policies, controls, and risk management practices
  • Translate legal and regulatory requirements relating to AI and automated decision-making into operational controls and guidance
  • Support responsible and compliant use of personal data in AI systems
  • Contribute to development of training, FAQs, and business guidance for AI usage
Data Privacy Program Enablement (Operationalisation)
  • Support and contribute to implementation of the organisations data privacy compliance program, including: privacy policies, standards, and procedures, data protection impact assessments (DPIAs)
  • Support responses to customer, vendor, and regulatory data protection queries
Incident Management Regulatory Support
  • Support privacy incident management processes, including coordination with cybersecurity teams
  • Contribute to incident assessments, escalation processes, and regulatory reporting inputs
  • Help define and refine roles, responsibilities, and handoffs between privacy and security incident processes
  • Support continuous improvement of incident response frameworks
Stakeholder Engagement Collaboration
  • Work closely with Legal, InfoSec, DIO, HR, Procurement, and other business functions across Equinix to support implementation of privacy requirements
  • Act as a translator between legal, technical, and business teams, ensuring clarity and alignment
  • Build strong working relationships to enable consistent and scalable adoption of privacy controls
  • Communicate risks, trade-offs, and priorities effectively across stakeholders
Tools, Automation, Monitoring Continuous Improvement
  • Support use and optimisation of privacy and compliance tools (e.g. OneTrust, ServiceNow)
  • Help design and implement monitoring, KPI tracking, and reporting frameworks to measure effectiveness of privacy controls
  • Contribute to development of audit-ready processes and evidence frameworks aligned to regulatory expectations
  • Drive continuous improvement of key processes, including privacy assessments
  • Identify and incorporate lessons learned from incidents, audits, and operational issues to continuously improve processes, controls, and documentation
  • Support automation and scalability of compliance operations
Qualifications
  • 8+ years of experience in technical privacy / privacy engineering, technology risk, compliance, or information security
  • Demonstrated experience working across legal, technical, and business domains
  • Experience supporting or implementing privacy and data protection programs
  • Experience developing and refining processes and documentation based on lessons learned

title: Senior Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Job Title : Senior Data Scientist Summary:

The Senior Data Scientist - Knowledge Representation is a core technical role on the Healthcare Supply Chain (HCSC) Knowledge Representation (KR) team. This role brings machine learning, data science, and AI capabilities directly in service of knowledge representation problems: entity resolution, knowledge graphs, embedding-based semantic alignment, LLM-assisted knowledge extraction, and validation of ontological claims against data.

Our platform connects hospitals, distributors, GPOs, manufacturers, and regulators, enabling transactional execution, clinical data alignment, and analytics optimization across organizational boundaries. Each party encodes its own implicit knowledge about the world in its schemas, identifiers, and workflows. The KR teams job is to make that implicit knowledge explicit, alignable, and trustworthy.

Essential Duties:

  • Design and implement knowledge representation solutions that balance performance and costs: using a variety of data stores (graph, document, tabular, vector).
  • Design, build, and maintain entity resolution systems.
  • Develop and own embedding-based and hybrid semantic similarity solutions.
  • Build and operate LLM-assisted knowledge extraction pipelines that identify ontological candidates from unstructured and semi-structured HCSC data sources.
  • Design and implement uncertainty quantification frameworks for KR outputs: confidence scoring for entity resolution decisions, calibration of alignment scores, and propagation of data quality signals through KR pipelines so that downstream consumers understand the reliability of what they receive.
  • Partner with data quality engineers to establish bidirectional feedback channels between KR pipeline failures and systematic data quality issues.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Stay current with developments in AI, ML and Data Science including knowledge graph embeddings, neuro-symbolic AI, and AI reasoning.

Competencies:

  • Strong ML engineering fundamentals: experience designing, training, evaluating, and operating models in production.
  • Genuine engagement with knowledge representation concepts: sufficient familiarity with OWL, description logics, and ontological commitments to reason about what an ML models outputs actually assert.
  • Understanding and expertise in embedding methods for knowledge graphs and text with practical experience applying them to similarity, matching, and alignment tasks, and understanding of their failure modes in sparse or structurally heterogeneous domains.
  • Practical LLM engineering skills: prompt engineering for structured extraction, fine-tuning or adapter methods for domain adaptation, retrieval-augmented generation for KR tasks, and rigorous evaluation of LLM outputs.
  • Proficiency in knowledge graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, property graphs) at a working level sufficient to query, evaluate, and annotate KR structures.
  • Excellent cross-disciplinary communication: able to explain statistical model behavior and uncertainty to stakeholders.
  • Comfort operating at the boundary of statistical and formal methods.
  • Requires minimal supervision on ML and data science work within the KR domain.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Greater than 4 years of applied ML and data science experience, with at least some portion of that work directly involving entity resolution, semantic matching, knowledge graph construction, or related knowledge representation problems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-assisted knowledge extraction: prompt design, structured output parsing, domain fine-tuning or few-shot adaptation.
  • Working knowledge of RDF and SPARQL.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement model evaluation frameworks.
  • Strong programming skills for ML pipeline development, data analysis, and tooling; proficiency with the standard ML stack (e.g. PyTorch or equivalent, HuggingFace, scikit-learn) and with graph data tooling (RDFLib, NetworkX, or equivalent).
  • Experience working in multi-disciplinary settings where ML outputs feed into formal systems or decision-making processes.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelors or advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Computational Linguistics, Information Science, or a related discipline; graduate work in knowledge representation, NLP, or information extraction is a strong plus.
  • Experience with neurosymbolic AI approaches: methods that combine learned representations with formal reasoning, constraint satisfaction, or logic-based inference - particularly in the context of knowledge graph completion, ontology alignment, or structured prediction tasks.
  • Healthcare supply chain domain knowledge.
  • Familiarity with OWL 2 and description logics at a reading level: not required to author axioms independently, but able to read OWL and understand what a reasoner computes.
  • Experience with graph database platforms at production scale.
